adopt.catalog.title: {label} component catalogue
adopt.catalog.intro: Generated by `adopt` from the {preset} preset ({version}). Classes use the prefix `{cls}`; tokens use `{prefix}`. Build only with the classes and tokens listed here.
adopt.catalog.themingBody: Set attributes on `<html>` only: `data-mode` ({modes}), `data-density` ({densities}), `data-brand` (default). Never set colours or sizes on the page directly.
adopt.catalog.layoutBody: App shell: `.{cls}app` holds `.{cls}topbar`, `.{cls}rail`, `.{cls}main` and `.{cls}tabbar`. The rail shows on medium and expanded windows (≥ 600 px), the tab bar on compact windows (< 600 px). `.{cls}container` limits the content width. Visibility: `.{cls}hide-compact`, `.{cls}hide-medium`, `.{cls}hide-expanded`, `.{cls}show-expanded`. Text styles: `.{cls}text-display`, `-headline`, `-title`, `-subtitle`, `-body-large`, `-body`, `-label`, `-caption`.
adopt.catalog.mapIntro: HTML class ↔ React (shadcn/ui) ↔ Vue (shadcn-vue). Registry names in brackets. "DS class" means: use the upstream element and add the DS class; there is no upstream component.
adopt.rules.title: {label} rules
adopt.rules.r1: Use semantic tokens only (`{prefix}text-*`, `bg-*`, `stroke-*`, `icon-*`, `space-*`, `size-*`, `radius-*`, `font-*`, `shadow-*`). Primitives (`{prefix}color-*`, `{prefix}num-*`) belong in the token files only.
adopt.rules.r2: No hex, rgb(), hsl() or px values for colour, spacing, radius or font size in apps when a token exists.
adopt.rules.r3: Do not override component CSS. A missing variant becomes a local component (`x-` prefix), then goes to `contribute`.
adopt.rules.r4: Set mode, density and brand only through `data-mode`, `data-density` and `data-brand` on `<html>`.
adopt.rules.r5: Touch targets are at least 48 × 48 px on touch screens. The components include it; keep it when you compose new ones.
adopt.rules.r6: Window size classes: compact < 600 px, medium 600–839 px, expanded ≥ 840 px. Navigation rail on medium and expanded, bottom tab bar on compact; never both at once.
adopt.rules.r7: Labels are always visible; a placeholder is never the label. Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
adopt.rules.r8: Inputs, checkboxes, radios and switch tracks use `{prefix}stroke-strong` (3:1 against the canvas, WCAG 1.4.11).
adopt.rules.r9: React and Vue: shadcn/ui and shadcn-vue components read the alias variables (`--background`, `--primary`, …) that the bundle maps to DS tokens. Never edit the alias block; change the DS tokens.
adopt.rules.r10: `--primary` and `--destructive` are fill colours (3:1). For text in brand or danger colour use `{prefix}text-brand` or `{prefix}text-danger` (4.5:1), not the `text-primary` / `text-destructive` utilities of shadcn.
adopt.rules.r11: Font: {font}. The profile ships no font files: self-host the font (check its licence) or rely on the system fallback.
adopt.rules.r12: Icons: Tabler Icons (MIT), outline, 24 px grid, stroke 2. Sizes: `{prefix}size-icon-sm`, `-md`, `-lg`.
adopt.rules.devInput: Input, checkbox, radio and switch borders use `stroke-strong` (3:1) instead of the preset's light `--input` border (about 1.3:1). Accessibility fix; keep it.
adopt.rules.devFocus: Focus ring: 2 px solid `stroke-focus` with a 2 px offset, instead of the preset's 3 px ring at 50 % opacity, so focus reaches 3:1.
adopt.rules.noneAdjusted: No tone adjustment: every role passed at its preset tone.
adopt.rules.composedIntro: Material Design 3 structure with preset tokens, because the layers clash or the preset has no such component. Check these first when the preset changes.
adopt.rules.contrastIntro: WCAG 2.x minimums: text 4.5:1; icons, strokes and component boundaries 3:1. Not checked: {exempt}.
adopt.changelog.title: Changelog
adopt.changelog.entry: Base profile created by `adopt` from the {preset} preset ({upstream}) with Material Design 3 structure. Seed {seed}, prefix `{prefix}`, radius {radius} px, font {font}, dark mode: {dark}, platforms: {platforms}.
adopt.lib.intro: Every component on this page uses the DS bundle only. Change the mode and density to check them.
adopt.lib.shellNote: This page uses the app shell: navigation rail at 600 px and wider, bottom tab bar below 600 px. The frame shows the compact top bar and tab bar.
